"You have to build custom software completely from scratch."

This is one of the most common misconceptions I hear from founders exploring new tools.

In reality, building from scratch for the sake of it is a waste of time and budget. The best custom solutions rely on robust, open-source foundations or existing libraries for standard features like auth, security, and data storage.

Your budget and time should go entirely toward what makes your business unique: your specific workflow, your proprietary logic, and your user experience.

Don't reinvent the wheel. Build the engine.
